import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
result = json.loads(Path('time_course.json').read_text())
assert result['times'] == [i * 0.5 for i in range(21)]
assert set(result['values']) == {'P'}
assert len(result['values']['P']) == 21
assert result['values']['P'][0] == 1.0
assert all(math.isclose(p, math.exp(-0.3*t), rel_tol=1e-8, abs_tol=1e-10) for t,p in zip(result['times'], result['values']['P']))
print(Path('time_course.json').read_text(), end='')
